name: omc-jev
description: Typed harness decisions ($.jev): Jev when a key is set, a small Claude model otherwise. Picks effort per prompt and resumes turns that stop mid-promise.

backend.title: Judge backend
backend.description: auto uses Jev when a key is set, else Claude

apiKey.title: Jev API key
apiKey.description: OpenRouter or TypeSafe key; falls back to OPENROUTER_API_KEY / TYPESAFE_API_KEY

judgeModel.title: Claude judge model
judgeModel.description: Model answering questions when Jev is not used

autoEffort.title: Auto effort
autoEffort.description: Judge each prompt's difficulty and set the turn's effort

maxEffort.title: Auto effort ceiling
maxEffort.description: Highest effort auto effort may pick

resumeOnStop.title: Resume unexpected stops
resumeOnStop.description: When a turn ends right after promising to act, start a turn that tells it to go on
